questions.prompt: What is the full range of port numbers?
questions.explanation: Ports are 16-bit numbers, so they range from 0 to 65535.

questions.prompt: Match each service to its default port.
questions.explanation: HTTP defaults to 80, HTTPS to 443, SSH to 22, and DNS to 53.

questions.prompt: The five values (protocol, source IP, source port, destination IP, destination port) that uniquely identify a connection are called the ____.
questions.explanation: The five-tuple uniquely identifies each connection, which is how one server port can serve many clients at once.

questions.prompt: Which band do ephemeral (dynamic) source ports fall in?
questions.explanation: IANA's dynamic/ephemeral range is 49152–65535; the OS picks source ports from here for outgoing connections.

questions.prompt: Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

options.text: A socket is an endpoint: an IP address plus a port for a protocol
TCP port 80 and UDP port 80 are different ports
One server port can serve many clients simultaneously
Two programs can listen on the same port and protocol at the same time

questions.explanation: Sockets are IP+port endpoints, ports are per-protocol, and one port serves many clients via distinct five-tuples. Two processes cannot bind the same port+protocol at once.

questions.prompt: Order the port bands from lowest numbers to highest.
questions.explanation: The IANA bands run well-known, then registered, then dynamic/ephemeral.
